messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Mixture Models
parts: I was wondering whether you might have a sense as to when mixture modeling might be available on Lavaan?

I don't think anytime soon.  From what I have seen on this forum, his plans for version 0.6 will be focused on incorporating multilevel data structures.  But there is an R package that does mixture modeling, although it's not quite as user-friendly:

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/nlsem/nlsem.pdf

Depending on what you were hoping to do (e.g., if it's possible to specify the mixture model in a framework other than SEM), you might find it useful to consider the "model-based clustering" section in this list of R packages:

https://cran.r-project.org/web/views/Cluster.html

Terry
